name: Major Project Part-2
description: In this project, the student must meet with the supervisor at least once a week to discuss the progress. The supervisor will steer the project's progress, validate the models, intermediate results, methodology, tools, and techniques per the project's requirements. The student must also develop mature research writing and presentation skills. By the end of major project part-2, the student should have completed the work worthy of a high-quality master's thesis in industrial engineering and operations research.
